dialogueLines.hi: Anaaj bhandaar tak ek aur phera.
dialogueLines.en: One more round to the granary.

dialogueLines.hi: Mehnat ka bojh bhi meetha lagta hai.
dialogueLines.en: Even the weight of hard work feels sweet.

dialogueLines.hi: Anaaj surakshit hai, shahar majboot hai.
dialogueLines.en: The grain is safe, the city is strong.

dialogueLines.hi: Har daana gina jaata hai yahan.
dialogueLines.en: Every grain is counted here.

dialogueLines.hi: Kuch raaz samay ke saath khulte hain.
dialogueLines.en: Some secrets open only with time.

dialogueLines.hi: Gyaan baantne se badhta hai.
dialogueLines.en: Knowledge grows by sharing.

dialogueLines.hi: Suna? Bazaar mein nayi mohar aayi hai.
dialogueLines.en: Heard? A new seal arrived in the bazaar.

dialogueLines.hi: Pakdo toh jaano!
dialogueLines.en: Catch me if you can!

dialogueLines.hi: Sabse tez main hoon!
dialogueLines.en: I'm the fastest of all!

dialogueLines.hi: Har gali ek kahani, har mod ek yaad.
dialogueLines.en: Every street a story, every turn a memory.

dialogueLines.hi: Smriti didi kehti hain, yaadein hi khazana hain.
dialogueLines.en: Smriti didi says memories are the real treasure.

dialogueLines.hi: Yahan shuddhi hai, yahan se nayi soch.
dialogueLines.en: Here is purity, and from here, new thought.

dialogueLines.hi: Snan sirf tan ka nahi, man ka bhi hota hai.
dialogueLines.en: Bathing cleanses the mind, not just the body.

dialogueLines.hi: Bhau bhau!
dialogueLines.en: Woof woof!

dialogueLines.hi: Bhau! Kaun aaya?
dialogueLines.en: Woof! Who's there?

dialogueLines.hi: Vyapar se badhta hai vishwas ka sansaar.
dialogueLines.en: Trade grows the world of trust.

dialogueLines.hi: Har mohar par vyapari ki pehchaan hoti hai.
dialogueLines.en: Each seal carries a trader's identity.

dialogueLines.hi: Jal ka pravah, jeevan ki chaah.
dialogueLines.en: The flow of water, the wish of life.

dialogueLines.hi: Hamari dhaki naaliyan apne samay se bahut aage thin.
dialogueLines.en: Our covered drains were far ahead of their time.

dialogueLines.hi: Sheher ki raksha, hamara dharam.
dialogueLines.en: Guarding the city is our duty.

dialogueLines.hi: Andar jao, par niyam yaad rakho.
dialogueLines.en: Go in, but remember the rules.

dialogueLines.hi: Savdhaan raho, swagat hai.
dialogueLines.en: Stay alert — and welcome.

dialogueLines.hi: Yeh dwar raat ko band hota hai.
dialogueLines.en: This gate closes at night.

dialogueLines.hi: Kal ke liye, aaj sambhalo.
dialogueLines.en: Save today for tomorrow.

dialogueLines.hi: Jal amrit hai, iski raksha karo.
dialogueLines.en: Water is nectar — protect it.
